description:
Configure Eclipse's Java Code Templates to enforce strict corporate coding standards.

Your task:
1. Open Window > Preferences > Java > Code Style > Code Templates.
2. Configure the 'Files' comment template to exactly:
   /*
    * Copyright (c) 2026 SecureBank Inc.
    * All rights reserved.
    * Confidential and Proprietary.
    */
3. Configure the 'Types' comment template to include:
   /**
    * @author ${user}
    */
4. Ensure 'Automatically add comments for new methods and types' is enabled or manually checked when creating the class.
5. Create a new Java class named 'BankAccount' in package 'com.securebank.core' within the 'BankSystem' project.
6. Ensure the 'Generate comments' option is checked in the New Java Class wizard so the templates are applied.
7. Save the file.
